product_overview: When a match is marked completed, the system automatically creates two PENDING split payment records (one per player) that divide the booking total equally and are traceable via VMS-{booking_id}-P{user_id}-{rand} reference codes.
core_goals: Automatically create two PENDING split Payment records (one per participant) when a match is finished.
Split the booking total equally (estimated_total + booking_fee) and format amounts to two decimal places.
Attach user_id and match_id to Payment records and allow multiple payments per booking via a (booking_id, user_id) unique constraint.
Ensure Payment creation is non-fatal to match completion (log failures, do not roll back match status).
Provide observability via existing payment listing API so operators can verify created payments.
Avoid circular imports by using lazy imports between MatchService and PaymentService.

features.name: Match Lifecycle API (Finish Match -> Trigger Split Payments)
features.description: Mark a match as COMPLETED; completion triggers automatic creation of split payment records (one per participant) using equal-split logic. Payment creation is attempted after the match is committed and is non-fatal if it fails.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/matches/{match_id}/finish with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with MatchObject (status='COMPLETED') -> GET /api/v1/payments with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with list containing two Payment objects where each payment has status='PENDING', match_id={match_id}, user_id set, and amount equals calculated split formatted to two decimals
POST /api/v1/matches/{invalid_match_id}/finish with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 400 with Error (match not found or invalid match_id)

POST /api/v1/matches/{match_id}/finish with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with MatchObject (status='COMPLETED') -> GET /api/v1/payments with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with list NOT containing payments for the match (payment creation failed but match remains COMPLETED and error is logged)

features.name: Payment Management API (List & Inspect Payments)
features.description: List payments created by the system (including split payments). Useful for operators and tests to verify payment records, statuses, and associations to match_id, booking_id and user_id.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/payments with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with array of Payment objects (each includes id, booking_id, match_id, user_id, provider='MANUAL_UPI' or other, status='PENDING'|'PAID', amount formatted to two decimals, reference_code following VMS-{booking_id}-P{user_id}-{rand})
GET /api/v1/payments without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized error
GET /api/v1/payments with Authorization: Bearer <token> when DB query fails -> Receive 500 Internal Server Error
